body.name: Measurable gate-and-fallback interval
body.construction: Let \(x_\eta=\log(6/\eta)\), \(S_T=K_1(n_T)^{-1}+K_0(n_T)^{-1}\), \(v_{T,\Delta}=\min\{1,L(1+g_{T,\Delta})^{-\beta}\}\), \(a_T=\sqrt{2S_Tx_\eta}\), and \(A_{a,T,\Delta}(x)=\sqrt{2v_{T,\Delta}x/J_a}+4x/(3J_a)\). Define \(I_{T,\Delta}^{\mathrm{conc}}=[\widehat\tau_{T,\Delta}\pm\{a_T+A_{1,T,\Delta}(x_\eta)+A_{0,T,\Delta}(x_\eta)+B_{T,\Delta}\}]\cap[-2,2]\). Define \(d_{T,\Delta}=A_{1,T,\Delta}(4\log T)+A_{0,T,\Delta}(4\log T)\) and \(I_{T,\Delta}^{\mathrm G}=[\widehat\tau_{T,\Delta}\pm\{\widehat s_{T,\Delta}c_\eta(B_{T,\Delta}/\widehat s_{T,\Delta})+d_{T,\Delta}\}]\cap[-2,2]\), with \(I_{T,\Delta}^{\mathrm G}=I_{T,\Delta}^{\mathrm{conc}}\) when \(\widehat s_{T,\Delta}=0\). Finally, \(I_{T,\Delta}=[-2,2]\) on \(E_T^c\), \(I_{T,\Delta}=I_{T,\Delta}^{\mathrm G}\) on \(E_T\cap G_{T,\Delta}\), and \(I_{T,\Delta}=I_{T,\Delta}^{\mathrm{conc}}\) on \(E_T\cap G_{T,\Delta}^c\).
